name: Kanturu Relics
note: Kanturu Relics, MU's map 38 (client Data/World39 + Object39, MuMain's WD_38KANTURU_2ND), Season 2 (2006), entered from the Ruins' Relics door (gate 129 to 130). An indoor-reading refinery maze in a flat 1.70 m floor: pale stone corridors lit bright down their middle, scaffolds and 29 m tank columns hung into the black round them. Step 1, 2026-10-21: the bare land, with no `rules` yet, so the realm does not know the map. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1.

spawn.note: OpenMU's spawn gate 137 (VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:283): the safe hall by the Ruins' door, where a death in the Relics or the boss map stands up. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part A 2.1.

exits.note: The Relics, from the Ruins (Gates.cs:285): the hall's west end, facing east, away from the way back (131) beside it.

enters.note: The Relics' way back to the Ruins (Gates.cs:540). MU asks 150, ours free, as every way out.

hidden.note: The Relics' emitter boxes (MoveKanturu2ndObject, GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:252-268): clouds, void glows, waterfall specks, water and thunder joints, every one an angeflo_R box drawn by no mesh. docs/worlds/kanturu-port.md Part B 8.1. And type 67 (Object68), ours: one more angeflo_R box, 0.9 m at 143,72 in the void, which MU's code leaves drawn, a green-sprite cube among the clouds (the user, 2026-10-24: "go").

void.note: The Ruins' numbers for a first look: 42.0% of the map is NoGround round the maze, and the cho_scarp scaffolds hang 6-9.5 m into it. Ours, to judge in the first shot.

void_fill.note: From the safe hall (spawn gate 137). The maze is one region of 4,454 tiles; the 75 stray open tiles on rows 250-251 become void. Ours.

airs_from.note: The crows (show.boids) are Blood Castle's Crow01, built in its folder (the user, 2026-10-23: "also maybe same birds which we had on BC").

perches.note: The Relics: MOVEMENT_OPERATE's Is_Kanturu2nd arm, `TargetType == 3: Sit = true` with no turn (ZzzInterface.cpp:1766-1772); CreateOperate (GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:41-44). The nine stone chairs, eight in the safe hall (73-82, 103 and 108) and one at 86,120 (the user, 2026-10-24: "next").

void_islands.note: Every drawn tile no walk from void_fill's seed touches becomes void: MU's ring of NoMove floor round the maze and the two strips five tiles off the safe hall (rows 75-95 and 116-127), which ended on hard tile edges. The void has clouds instead (the user, 2026-10-24: "still see some ground outside the platform, we are using void with clouds now"). Ours, marked; pipeline/terrain.py VOID_ISLANDS.

npcs.name: Gateway Machine
npcs.note: MU's place: OpenMU KanturuRelics.cs:46, 141,191 facing south, at the head of the Laser Trap corridor (x 138-144, y 166-183), on a NoMove tile; reached from 141,186 (the user, 2026-10-23: put it where it has to be). The tower event it opens is not built.

rules.note: Kanturu Relics, MU's map 38, entered from the Ruins' door (gates 129/131). arrive is the middle of spawn gate 137's box, the safe hall (OpenMU VersionSeasonSix Gates.cs:283), where a death in the Relics stands up too (OM's spawn gate; WZ's 139 lies inside the same hall). The Town Portal goes to Tarkan's town (home 8), as the Ruins'. Last on the M key's walk (12), so no other map's order moves. No drops yet: no breed stands here.

void_clouds.note: Big slow clouds drifting through the void round the maze (game/world/void_clouds.h), in place of cliffs (the user, 2026-10-23: "lets not use cliffs at all, but use clouds which we used for other maps to fill balck voids"). Blood Castle's cold grey at 1.8 times, so the top deck (0.3-1.6 m under the floor) reads as a smoke layer over the sunk crystals (the user, 2026-10-24: "we need smoke layer coming above crystals levels").

boids.note: Blood Castle's crows (MODEL_CROW, GOBoid.cpp:1342-1345; SOUND_CROW a frame in 128, :1495-1501) over the Relics' void and its clouds. Ours: MU flies none here (the user, 2026-10-23: "also maybe same birds which we had on BC").

crystal_chrome.note: The crystals' second pass, mesh 0 again RENDER_CHROME7 with BITMAP_CHROME (Render_Kanturu2nd_AfterObjectMesh type 76, GM_Kanturu_2nd.cpp:662), as the Ruins' Object96 takes it: Chrome01 added at the body light, slid by the normals and WorldTime*0.00006. game/world/crystal_sparks.h lendCrystalChrome. (the user, 2026-10-24: "nextwhats next", effects 1).

ruin_effects.note: The jade towers' spark and bolts (Object09, kind tower): game/world/ruin_effects.h, the Ruins' tank arcs' class. (the user, 2026-10-24: "next", effects 2).
